descriptions.w3d_global_light_destroy_800c000c: Destructor for the global light object: clears the active-light pointer, releases two held resources and runs the base destructor.
descriptions.w3d_global_light_handle_800c0090: Message handler for the global light: sets it up on attach, tears it down on detach, otherwise defers to the base handler.
descriptions.w3d_global_light_attach_800c0440: Looks up the ambient and diffuse light resources by name, refreshes the light state and makes this the active global light.
descriptions.w3d_light_set_position_800c125c: Copies a three-float position into the indexed light entry when a global light is active.
descriptions.w3d_light_set_attachment_800c1294: Replaces the attachment held by the indexed light entry, attaches it to the entry's light, and releases the passed reference.
descriptions.w3d_light_set_scale_800c1348: Stores a float scale into the indexed light entry when a global light is active.
